title: eugenia montalbanica
intro: Eugenia montalbanica, commonly known as the Philippine mountain mayana, is a plant species native to the Philippines. It is a small tree or shrub with medicinal properties, valued for its health benefits, therapeutic actions, and bioactive constituents. Eugenia montalbanica has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Eugenia montalbanica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
